I’m ready to generate the Problem List Clinical Note, but I don’t yet have the transcript or the DDx content. Please provide:

- The full transcript (doctor–patient conversation) text.
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

Once I have these, I will produce:

- Consult Summary: two-line, high-level summary.
- Problem List with Issue 1–3, each including:
  - Brief issue description with timeline and symptoms
  - Systems review (pertinent positives/negatives)
  - Social history, medications, and exam findings if mentioned
  - Differential diagnosis from the DDx (only if consistent with transcript), with brief likelihood (High/Moderate/Low) and one-line justification
- Medications: list of meds mentioned (with “dose/route/frequency not documented” if not provided)
- Allergies: listed allergies
- Past Medical History: relevant PMH
- Social History: living, smoking, alcohol, etc.
- Preventative History: screenings and vaccines mentioned
- Physical Examination: vitals and exam findings as provided
- Plan: required actions, tests, treatment changes, follow-up
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, conflicts, or transcript quality issues

Important rules I’ll follow:
- Do not introduce new data beyond the transcript or DDx.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I’ll annotate “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If transcript and DDx conflict, I’ll include both and mark “conflict noted.”
- Use American English, concise professional bullet points, exact structure/heading order.

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON when ready.
